name: cx-goal-one-rule~p2
task: Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed. Open the door, then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Absence(key_lost) is correctly soft, since 'Try not to' scopes only the key drop, and key_lost already means the key is dropped while the door is closed, so the key drop that frees the hands once the door is open is not penalized. Existence(target_picked_up) plus the hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) match 'Open the door, then pick up the box'; the chain forces door_open, so no Existence(door_open) is needed. The ball and key prerequisites are guaranteed by the environment and need no clause.

texts: Avoid losing the matching key before the door is opened.
Pick up the mission's target box.
Open the door before picking up the target box.
